pages.title: IRON NEST Units & Enemies Database - 26 Verified Types
pages.description: Compare 275 spawn nodes across 87 raw IDs, 26 reviewed units, 51 mission-only IDs and seven reference markers; all canonical merges retain every source row.
pages.source_unique_value_statement: 把275个生成节点压缩为87个原始ID，并落实为26个经站长复核的独立单位页、51个任务内嵌ID和7个Reference坐标标记；四组大小写/拼写变体在保留全部源记录的前提下使用canonical ID对外展示。
